text: it came to pass: Or, there was a day
an half acre of land: Or, half a furrow of an acre of land
a very great trembling: Heb. a trembling of God
assembled themselves: Heb. were cried together
with him: Heb. in his hand
the same was the first altar: Heb. that Altar he began to build unto the LORD
Give: Or, shew the innocent | escaped: Heb. went forth
gathered an host: Or, wrought mightily
